title: Senior AEM Engineer
description:

This role will be also responsible to work with team of developers under the guidance of technical lead to deliver the requirements. This role will also be responsible for supporting existing implementation via enhancements and bug fixes.

In addition to strong technical knowledge of the AEM and integrated platform this position requires strong communication and interpersonal skills to build and maintain trusted relationships with various business stack holders and partners. Work will be managed with supervision of lead and encouraged to take initiative on ideas, best practices etc...

* Ensures the delivery and success of AEM enterprise-level integration and development involving upstream and downstream systems
* Participates in gathering of technical and functional requirements from business teams during discovery phase and translate it into AEM solution and document it
* Create development approach along with team and present it for approval with technical leader board along with efforts
* Should be hand on AEM features and functionality to develop custom solution including back-end integration and ready to develop them along with development team
* Should be creative and OOTB thinker to bring best practices in development approaches
* Suggest alternative technical solutions to meet business requirements more efficiently and/or with greater reusability and/or long-term solution
* Perform reviews and provide inputs/directions to the development team during design and development phase
* Experience and exposure in agile methodologies.
* Excellent communication skills and customer relationship building skills

* Strong hands-on experience of AEM Components, editable Templates, Client Libraries, Taxonomy, metadata management, Forward and Reverse Replication, Workflows, Content Publishing, Tagging, Campaigns, Analytics and Targeting.
* Experienced with third party integrations e.g. Search Integrations, Authentication Handlers, Web services Integrations, etc

* Good understanding of AEM capabilities including Multi-site manager and Blueprinting, and the use of Online marketing components such as advanced targeting/ personalization, and multi-variate testing.
* Should have configured and designed AEM multi-tenant solutions and delivered it

* Experience in performing product and technology research and analysis to formulate solutions to business specific requirements

**Experience**

* Overall 5+ years of experience in delivering enterprise solutions
* Minimum 4+ years of experience developing with AEM Touch UI(version 6.4 and higher, As a Cloud Service will be preferred)
* Minimum 4+ years solution designing & executing AEM sites build:
  + Editable Template
  + Touch UI Components (React/Sightly/JSP/Java/Angular)
  + Servlet, Services, Third Party Integration
  + Server side caching build (symphony, EHcache etc…)
  + Context Hub and campaign
  + Sling models and exposure
  + Experience and content fragment
  + Context aware configuration (OSGI configuration)
  + Styling system/Multitenant architecture
  + MSM (Blueprint, Live copy, Language copy)
  + Replication and triggering jobs or event on activation/deactivation
  + Dispatcher configuration
  + Front end and server side debugging and fixing issue
  + Performance improvement and SEO debugging and tracking
* Experience with Analytics tools like (google analytics or adobe analytics)
* Experience with targeting tools like (Adobe Target or double click etc…)
* Experience with Tagging system like (google tag manager or adobe launch)
* Experience with eCommerce platform Magento aka Adobe commerce will be plus
* Experience with integrating SalesForce will be plus
* Experience with integrating Product management system will be plus
* Experience utilizing BitBucket, GitHub, Jira and Confluence
* Experience with cloud offerings as a hosting platform
* Experience on designing CI/CD process
* Experience on customizing GDPR presentation
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability with a commitment to deliver quality outcomes that balance technical and business goals
* Broad web and digital knowledge with an aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving.

title: India - Senior Manager WOP
description:
**Who are Inchcape**  
At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations.

We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.

**Main Purpose of Job :**

* Lead the World of Ports (WOP) marine data and operational delivery function, acting as the senior maritime subject-matter expert between global Inchcape teams, product, technology and customers.
* Own delivery against KPIs for collection, verification, validation and publication of port, terminal, berth, vessel and marine-operational datasets and APIs, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and operational relevance.
* Translate practical seagoing and port-operational expertise into product requirements, customer use cases and continuous improvements that support safe, efficient and commercially sound maritime decision-making.

  

**Key Accountabilities :**

* Lead, coach and develop the WOP marine/data operations team, setting clear standards for performance, quality and professional growth.
* Act as the senior marine subject-matter expert for port, terminal, berth, vessel and cargo operations across WOP products and services.
* Own marine-data governance, validation standards and quality controls to ensure data is operationally credible, consistent and fit for customer use.
* Engage directly with shipowners, operators, charterers, terminals, ports and other customers to understand operational needs and convert feedback into actionable requirements.
* Build strong working relationships across the Inchcape global network to improve source coverage, verification discipline and timeliness of marine information.
* Partner with Product, Technology and Data teams to define specifications, acceptance criteria and priorities for maritime data and digital solutions.
* Provide marine-operational oversight for new datasets, APIs and product features, ensuring outputs reflect real-world shipping and port workflows.
* Use data and domain insight to identify gaps, trends and opportunities, providing clear recommendations that support the WOP product roadmap.
* Manage multiple workstreams and improvement initiatives, balancing operational delivery, customer priorities, risk and strategic objectives.
* Establish and maintain SOPs, controls, documentation and audit trails that strengthen operational resilience and data quality.
* Represent WOP in customer and stakeholder forums, communicate progress to senior management, and support sprint/release readiness from a marine-business perspective.

  

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Demonstrable senior-level maritime experience with strong practical knowledge of vessel operations, ports, terminals, berths, cargo operations and port agency workflows.
* Strong marine assurance and operational risk mindset, with the ability to assess the reliability and operational relevance of maritime information.
* Consistently high data quality, verification and service performance against agreed KPIs and customer expectations.
* Successful conversion of marine-domain knowledge and customer feedback into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Effective leadership of a geographically dispersed team, with measurable improvements in capability, accountability, quality and productivity.
* Trusted engagement with senior internal stakeholders and external maritime customers, supported by clear, credible and concise communication.
* Successful delivery of marine-data, API and digital initiatives in partnership with Product, Technology and Data teams.
* Well-governed processes, SOPs and controls that support traceability, continuous improvement and operational resilience.
* Proactive identification of data gaps, customer pain points and maritime-market opportunities that inform the WOP roadmap and priorities.

  

**Skills and Experience required :**

* **Marine Operations Expertise**: In-depth knowledge of vessel operations, ports, terminals, berths, cargo handling, port agency processes and ship/shore interfaces.
* **Seagoing / Marine Background**: Senior officer-level seagoing or equivalent shore-based marine operations experience, with strong practical understanding of shipboard and port operations.
* **Marine Assurance & Risk**: Sound knowledge of marine assurance, operational risk, HSSE principles and safe operating practices relevant to vessels and terminals.
* **Data Governance**: Ability to define verification rules, quality controls and governance standards for critical maritime operational data.
* **Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**: Credible communication with shipowners, operators, charterers, ports, terminals, agents and senior internal stakeholders.
* **Product & Business Translation**: Ability to convert marine workflows, operational pain points and customer needs into product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* **Digital Maritime Transformation**: Strong understanding of maritime digitalisation, data platforms, APIs, vessel/port intelligence and technology-enabled operational decision support.
* **Team Leadership**: Proven ability to lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams while setting clear performance standards.
* **Project & Delivery Management**: Ability to manage concurrent workstreams, priorities, risks, dependencies and delivery milestones in a fast-paced environment.
* **Commercial Awareness**: Understanding of how reliable port and vessel intelligence supports voyage planning, chartering, operations, demurrage, risk and customer value.
* **Analytical Capability**: Ability to interpret complex maritime datasets, identify anomalies and trends, and communicate practical insights to technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Change & Continuous Improvement**: Ability to improve processes, introduce new standards and guide teams through operational and technology change.
* **Communication & Reporting**: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including senior-management reporting and customer-facing presentations.
* **Problem Solving & Judgement**: Sound operational judgement with a structured approach to resolving data, process, customer and delivery issues.

  

**Experience :**

  

* **Maritime Experience**: Typically 10+ years in shipping, marine operations, ports, terminals, vessel operations or closely related maritime roles.
* **Senior Marine Responsibility**: Experience at senior officer level at sea (preferably Master Mariner / Chief Engineer / Chief Officer / Second Engineer) or equivalent senior shore-based marine responsibility.
* **Port & Terminal Operations**: Hands-on exposure to port calls, berth/terminal operations, cargo operations, marine services and ship/shore coordination.
* **Marine Assurance**: Experience applying marine assurance, HSSE, operational risk or compliance principles in vessel, port or terminal environments.
* **Leadership & People Management**: Proven experience leading teams, setting standards, managing performance and developing capability.
* **Maritime Data / Digital Solutions**: Experience using or delivering maritime data, port intelligence, vessel-tracking, API, analytics or other digital shipping solutions.
* **Customer Relations**: Experience engaging maritime customers and stakeholders, gathering requirements and resolving operational or service issues.
* **Product / Project Delivery**: Experience contributing to or leading product, data or technology initiatives from requirement definition through implementation.
* Data Quality & Governance: Experience establishing validation processes, quality controls, SOPs and traceable governance for operational information.

* **Cross-functional Working**: Demonstrated ability to work effectively across marine operations, commercial, product, technology and data teams.
* **Global / Distributed Operations**: Experience working across different geographies, cultures and time zones in a global maritime environment.
* **Change Management**: Track record of implementing process or technology change while maintaining operational delivery.
* **Executive Communication**: Experience providing concise progress, risk and recommendation updates to senior management and external stakeholders.
* **Continuous Improvement****:** Demonstrated record of improving operational quality, efficiency, customer outcomes or data reliability

  

**Education and Professional Qualification :**

**Essential:** Recognised marine qualification and substantial maritime operating experience.

**Preferred:** Master Mariner (STCW II/2), Chief Engineer (STCW III/2), or equivalent senior deck/engine certification. Alternatively, a degree in Nautical Science, Marine Engineering, Maritime Studies or Marine Operations supported by significant vessel, port or terminal experience. A relevant management, project-management or digital/data qualification is advantageous.

title: Commercial Manager, Life of Mine Solutions
description:
Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future?

We believe we can develop the technology and gain the know-how to make a difference. It’s a big responsibility, and we are committed to making an impactful positive change. We need your skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfil our goal. Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials and technology needed for a better future.

**Commercial Strategy & Deal Structuring**

* **Outcome-based models:** Build and price lifecycle agreements cost-per-tonne, take-or-pay, performance bonus and penalty structures, availability and throughput commitments.
* **Indexing & term:** Set multi-year index mechanics and term structures that protect FLS margin without. Define what good looks like before we commit externally.
* **Consignment & ownership:** Structure equipment ownership, consignment parts, and inventory models that the customer and FLS can both stand behind.
* **Go/no-go discipline:** Apply a clear deal evaluation framework. To advise whether we walk away from deals we cannot deliver or cannot price with confidence.

**Bid, Negotiation & Contract**

* **Commercial offers:** Lead the build of commercial proposals and pricing. Make sure pricing transparency, KPI definitions, and wear thresholds are defined and defensible, not left open.
* **Negotiation:** Run commercial negotiation with the customer, holding the line on the points that carry real risk and conceding where it does not.
* **Contract integrity:** Work with legal to close performance language gaps, per-KPI cap contradictions, and definition risk before signature, not after a dispute.
* **One FLS:** Make sure product, service, supply chain, digital, and execution are aligned on the commitment before it goes to the customer.

**Execution Readiness & Delivery Alignment**

* **Operational truth:** Logically test every commercial model against operational reality. A model that ignores site conditions is a future loss.
* **Handover:** Hand agreements to the delivery teams with the commercial logic, obligations, and risk points named clearly. Nothing implied.
* **Performance tracking:** Define how each agreement's performance should be measured and reported, so bonus / penalty mechanics for example are based on agreed data, not argument.

**Pipeline, Reporting & Governance**

* Support and maintain a structured commercial pipeline from opportunity through to signed agreement, with clear ownership at each stage for the sales regions you are working with
* Report deal status, margin, and commercial risk to leadership with the call a action and owner named, not just an observation.
* Maintain commercial templates and pricing tools so the team works from a consistent, disciplined base.

**Commercial Tools, Estimating & Standards**

* **Commercial tooling:** Support the development and ongoing improvement of the commercial tools the team relies on pricing models, offer templates, deal evaluation and go / no-go frameworks. Keep them practical and used, not shelfware.
* **Estimating tools:** Support the build and maintenance of estimating tools and cost models, Maintenance reference documents so estimators price lifecycle scope from a consistent, defensible base and the assumptions behind a number are clear.
* **Commercial & legal guidelines:** Work with legal to develop and maintain commercial and legal guidelines for long-term agreements: term and indexation mechanics, KPI and wear-threshold definitions, liability and cap structures, bonus / penalty language. Give the team a clear standard to work from before negotiation, not after a dispute.
* **Equipment-specific packages:** Develop repeatable, equipment-specific commercial packages for the core FLS product lines, so a lifecycle offer for a given asset starts from a proven template rather than a blank page.
* **Version control & ownership:** Own version control on tools, templates, and guidelines so the team works from one current source, with changes named and dated.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships**

* Socialize deals, strategic or commercial approach with regional leadership, sales teams, product ownership
* Engage mining operators, internal product, and regional operations to identify and qualify lifecycle opportunities worth pursuing.
* Represent FLS in commercial discussions, performance reviews, and customer planning sessions over the life of the agreement.
* Run competitive intelligence on rival lifecycle and performance-based offers to keep FLS's commercial position sharp.

**Team Support & Mentorship**

* Coach estimators GBC and commercial team members on deal structuring, pricing discipline, and the go/no-go framework.
* Build commercial capability across the team so quality does not depend on a single person.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* **Win rate on lifecycle deals:** Percentage of qualified opportunities converted to signed agreements.
* **Margin integrity:** Delivered margin against committed margin across the active agreement portfolio.
* **Cycle time:** Average time from qualified opportunity to signed agreement.
* **Execution alignment:** Percentage of signed deals delivered without commercial dispute or unplanned concession.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Deep understanding of outcome-based commercial models in mining - cost-per-tonne, take-or-pay, consignment, bonus/penalty mechanics.
* Strong grasp of fixed plant and lifecycle equipment economics: availability, throughput, wear life, repair and renewal.
* Commercial negotiation and contract construction, including working with legal on performance language and risk.
* Ability to connect commercial structure to operational delivery - commercial models built on operational truth, not optimism.
* Clear, direct written and verbal communication, including presenting to senior leaders and customers and holding a position under challenge.
* Strong commercial judgment and the discipline to walk away from a deal that does not hold up.
* Comfort working across product, service, supply chain, digital, and execution to deliver one FLS to the customer.

**Education & Experience**

* **Work experience:** Minimum 10 years in mining, industrial services, or capital equipment, with a strong record in commercial deal structuring and negotiation.
* Demonstrated experience building and closing multi-year, outcome-based or performance contracts with measurable commercial results.
* Experience leading and developing commercial team members, including geographically dispersed teams.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**Special Requirements**

* Ability to travel approximately 30 percent of the time, including internationally to mine sites and customer locations.
* Valid driver's license and passport.

**Core Competencies**

* **Business acumen:** Clear grasp of mining industry trends, risk, and market dynamics that drive FLS's lifecycle business internationally.
* **Drive for results:** Takes accountability for the commercial outcome and success of the deals owned.
* **Influence and persuade:** Convinces customers and internal stakeholders to align on a course of action; holds a position when challenged.
* **Decision making:** Takes personal responsibility for commercial decisions and their impact, including when data is incomplete.
* **Critical thinking:** Structured analysis of commercial and operational risk to reach a defensible position.

**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness.
